sources.name: G3P v1.12 storage compartments
sources.note: LISFLOOD surface water and related GWS benchmark; April 2002–September 2023.

sources.name: GLDAS Noah
sources.note: Four soil layers, canopy and snow. Noah does not contain groundwater storage.

sources.name: GROW observational groundwater database
sources.note: 511 Thai wells; 5,484 observed aggregates. Package CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Thai source metadata CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: FAO Global Map of Irrigation Areas v5
sources.note: Static equipped-area and inferred groundwater-irrigation proxies; not pumping measurements.

sources.name: GRACE and GRACE-FO
sources.note: Local monthly TWSA input; nominal 0.25° sampling is not independent spatial resolution.

sources.name: ESA CCI Soil Moisture
sources.note: Surface and 0–1 m root-zone predictor anomalies.

sources.name: WaterGAP naturalized and historical-human simulations
sources.note: GSWP3–ERA5 through 2023. Paired human run DOI 10.25716/GUDE.14B4-KQ6R. CC BY 4.0.

meta.interpretation: Candidate human residual includes model and observation error; it is not proven causal abstraction.
meta.author: Farzeen Khan
meta.method: Naturalized WaterGAP baseline and paired human experiment; emulator skill is not independent validation
